name: Prisoners
storyline:
It’s the beginning of term, you’re supposed to be in your school dorms, but instead you wake up in a room you’ve never seen before.

And you’re not alone. A young man—A stranger—is there with you. He insists that he has no idea how either of you ended up there

Then you receive an announcement.

You two were selected to be in a special program. Instead of your usual school program you are to spend your lives up until graduation in this room designed for you.

Every three days you have an examination.

The person with the highest passing score will get to leave the room and graduate, returning to society. The other person will be executed.

However, if neither of you pass the exam nothing changes the process will repeat until either the end of both your lives.... or until someone graduates.

The young man suggests to fail every exam together. But is that what he really intends to do? And could you really spend the rest of your life in a small cell with a stranger?

And if he really is a stranger...

How did he know your name before you ever introduced yourself?
